title: GCM decrypt: authTagSz < 12 accepted, FIPS minimum not enforced
description: Trigger: wc_AesGcmDecrypt with authTagSz=4 (or any 1-11). Path: crypto2dev_cipher → authTagSz > 0 && authTagSz <= CRYPTO2DEV_TAG_MAXLEN (16) → passes SET_TAG ioctl to kernel with a 4-byte tag. Bad outcome: if the kernel backend (kcapi or non-FIPS wolfssl) accepts a 4-byte auth tag, authentication strength is 2^32; FIPS 140-3 mandates minimum 96-bit (12-byte) GCM tags. The shim's decrypt-path guard (line 737) rejects NULL/zero/oversized tags but has no floor at 12 bytes. The encrypt GET_TAG path has the same gap. Fix: add authTagSz < GCM_NONCE_MID_SZ (12) → CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE for both encrypt GET_TAG and decrypt SET_TAG.
